MU.title_zh: 财报会前核对：Q4 毛利加速与下一季指引
MU.user_request: I am preparing a Micron earnings briefing. Reconstruct Q4 from the annual and nine-month filings, reconcile it to the earnings release, then test whether the next-quarter guidance meets my stated revenue and gross-margin hurdles.
MU.scope: FY2025 annual/Q3/Q4 and FY2026 Q1 guidance as announced 2025-09-23

steps.title_zh: 建立年度毛利基线
年度减累计反推 Q4
与业绩附件对账
指引区间相对实际季度的增长
按用户双门槛形成简报结论

STX.title_zh: 现金股息承受力：从已实现现金流到压力测试
STX.user_request: I want a Seagate dividend-coverage workpaper. Establish annual cash generation, compare actual dividends, estimate the newly declared dividend run rate, and stress-test it without treating my assumptions as company guidance.
STX.scope: FY2025 ended 2025-06-27; dividend announced 2025-07-29; explicit hypothetical stress

steps.title_zh: 取得现金流输入并计算 FCF
检验已支付股息覆盖
估算新股息的全年现金负担
现金流下降 15% 的覆盖压力
求最大可承受回撤并核对压力结果

WDC.title_zh: 分拆后的盈利口径与季度利润桥
WDC.user_request: I am reconciling Western Digital earnings after the Sandisk separation. Establish the correct continuing-operations boundary, bridge total and continuing profit, then check whether Q4 continuing net margin improved from Q3.

steps.title_zh: 先确定分拆后的口径
按上一步口径取年度财务基线
年度总利润桥接到持续经营
把 Q3 与年度持续经营基线对齐
用 Q4 业绩附件完成季度趋势判断

SNDK.title_zh: 扭亏核验：减值消退还是经营改善
SNDK.user_request: I am checking whether Sandisk's apparent Q4 recovery reflects underlying operating improvement or a disappearing goodwill charge, and whether the next-quarter release actually confirms a GAAP EPS turnaround.
SNDK.scope: FY2025 Q3/Q4, FY2025 annual impairment, FY2026 Q1 guidance issued 2025-08-14

steps.title_zh: 建立 Q3 亏损基线
只加回商誉减值
将 Q4 与原始及调整后 Q3 对比
验证全年减值并量化利润桥
缺失 GAAP 指引时不宣称确认扭亏
